ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (18) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Леса» (lesa, 'scaffolding') is kept as one image throughout passage 1, and «пуд» (pud, a Russian weight of about 16 kg) is kept as 'poods'. «Дух» (dukh, 'spirit') and «духовное» (dukhovnoe, 'the spiritual') are kept literal, and in the Cicero passage the spirit is the subject that moves and governs the body, as in the Russian, not a relative clause.
